question: The average age of 37 students of a class is 42 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 43 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = 43 years

Number of initial members = 37

Increase in average = 43 − 42 = 1 year

Age of Teacher = New Average + (Initial Members × Increase in Average)

Age of Teacher = 43 + (37 × 1) = 80 years

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 37

Average age of students = 42 years

New average including teacher = 43 years

Total number of people = 37 + 1 = 38
